title: Team Lead
description:
Job Overview

* **Role Title:** Sales Team Lead / Sales Business Development Manager (BDM)
* **Locations:** Malappuram, Kannur, Thrissur, Trivandrum (Kerala)
* **Compensation:** 35K - 40K + Performance Incentives
* **Benefits:** Accommodation Available

Company Description

ALIMS School of Business is committed to developing future-ready leaders through specialized, industry-focused courses that encourage innovation and practical learning. The institution emphasizes career readiness with dedicated placement support, helping learners transition smoothly into the professional world. Affordable programs make quality business education accessible to a wide range of aspiring professionals. Learners benefit from a supportive environment that values growth, performance, and continuous improvement.

Role Description

ALIMS School of Business is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Sales Team Lead / BDM to spearhead regional student outreach operations and lead a high-performing admissions team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing professional outreach strategies, mentoring and supervising branch representatives, and guiding the student enrollment journey from initial inquiry to final registration.

You will analyze regional market trends, set performance milestones, and collaborate closely with marketing and academic teams to ensure institutional goals are successfully met. This position requires a natural leader who excels at counseling prospective students and parents, nurturing professional relationships, and driving team productivity.

Key Responsibilities

* **Team Leadership & Mentoring:** Lead, train, and supervise branch sales executives, setting activity goals and tracking conversion metrics.
* **Pipeline & Admissions Management:** Oversee the full outreach funnel from prospecting and inquiry nurturing to counseling prospective students and completing admissions.
* **Strategic Outreach & Market Analysis:** Identify regional opportunities, analyze sector trends, and contribute to student acquisition initiatives.
* **CRM & Reporting:** Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, oversee system updates, and present periodic performance reports to management.
* **Event Coordination:** Drive institutional outreach by supporting open houses, career seminars, educational expos, and campus visits.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Experience:** Proven background (3+ years) in sales, team management, or business development—preferably within higher education, EdTech, or professional training.
* **Sales & Closing Acumen:** Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed performance targets.
* **Leadership Capability:** Prior experience leading, motivating, and evaluating team members to maximize productivity.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal, presentation, and listening skills to engage prospective students and families.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Familiarity with CRM software, lead tracking tools, and MS Excel/Google Sheets for data organization.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Flexibility:** Comfortable working on-site across designated branch locations in Kerala.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Area Sales Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Area Sales Manager \- Signages \& LED Letter Boards

**Company:**Trueads Pvt Ltd

**Location:** Trivandrum \| Ernakulam \| Pathanamthitta \| Kottayam (Kerala)

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Department:** Sales \& Business Development

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an energetic, target\-driven **Area Sales Executive / Manager** to handle field sales and client acquisition across southern and central Kerala districts (**Trivandrum, Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, and Kottayam**).

The ideal candidate must have a solid background in B2B sales and technical knowledge of **signboards, LED letter boards,visual branding solutions**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Market Expansion:** Identify, visit, and pitch signage solutions to retail stores, commercial hubs, corporate offices, and new business developments.
* **Product Consultation:** Understand client visual branding requirements and pitch custom solutions including 3D LED acrylic letters, neon boards, ACP signages, and outdoor displays.
* **Lead Generation \& Conversion:** Convert inbound inquiries and generate self\-sourced leads across assigned territories (Tvm, Ekma, Pta, Ktym).
* **Client Visits \& Site Measurements:** Coordinate initial site visits, measurements, and structural requirements with the estimation and fabrication teams.
* **Negotiation \& Closing:** Prepare quotations, negotiate deals, close sales contracts, and meet monthly revenue targets.
* **Account Management:** Build long\-term relationships with architects, interior designers, commercial contractors, and business owners.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum **3 years of proven sales experience** in field sales / B2B sales (Direct experience in Signage, Printing, Advertising, or Building Materials preferred).
* **Product Knowledge:** Strong knowledge of **LED letter boards, 3D channel letters, ACP cladding, flex/vinyl printing, and illuminated signboards**.
* **Territory Knowledge:** Strong familiarity with business markets across **Trivandrum, Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, and Kottayam**.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal negotiation skills in **Malayalam** and basic conversational English/Hindi.
* **Mobility:** Must possess a valid driver’s license and a **two\-wheeler** for field travel.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* **Salary:** Competitive Fixed Salary (15000 \- ₹30000 per month based on experience).
* Attractive Sales Commission / Incentives structure.
* Fuel \& Travel Allowances.
* Fast\-track career growth options.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
